relations: Icicles hang vertically from the gutter edge, their mass suspended by ice adhesion to the roof.
Meltwater pools at tapered tips, forming droplets that detach and fall when surface tension is exceeded.
Refreezing of dripping water lengthens icicles, while warming thins them and sheds small fragments.
The dark wall behind frames falling droplets and any ice pieces released from the tips.
